A good rule of thumb is to anchor these touchpoints to natural milestones—such as project completions or existing one-on-ones—rather than creating standalone check-ins more than once every few weeks. If you feel the urge to follow up again, pause and ask yourself whether you have a new concrete example to discuss—if not, wait until you do.
